name: astrolabe
description: Astrolabe : visualiseur local de coffre Markdown compatible Obsidian.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && vite build
